summary: Bolivia’s ecosystem pledges are restoration-oriented. By 2035, restoration, afforestation and reforestation will add 1,000,000 hectares of forest cover—about 1.6% of 2022 forest cover—while protecting and restoring 11,000,000 hectares of priority forest ecosystems, equivalent to 17.7% of 2022 forest area. Conservation measures target an 80% reduction in deforestation outside protected areas, 100% inside them, and a 60% reduction in fire-affected area. Integrated action covers 1,000,000 hectares of agricultural soils (about 14.0% of 2022 agricultural area), includes a 1,000,000-hectare agroforestry target, 25,000 hectares of SAF systems, 20,000 hectares of resilient fruit systems, 2,500,000 hectares of sustainably used forest (4.0% of 2022 forest cover), 40,000 hectares of recharge zones and degradation control on 19,800 hectares. Agriculture targets 40% of climate-affected production units, sustainable livestock practices on 155,000 hectares, water-efficient irrigation on 653,981 hectares, a 30% crop-yield gain, resilience for 400,000 producers and a 276 million tCO₂-eq emissions cut.
